ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the lateral lobes. A central, low-intensity black anchor-shaped region extends from the peduncle transition toward the trailing edge. Distinct small-diameter black pixel clusters (mottling) are scattered within the white fields, particularly near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible central V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 85 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.12 relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge (viewer perspective) shows low-amplitude undulations. Right trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations and irregular peaks, indicating significant edge erosion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular, high-contrast dark rings (pixels < 40 intensity) detected; one located on the lower-medial section of the left lobe and another on the medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible, including a prominent horizontal mark on the lower left lobe and vertical rake-like streaks on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular erosion/amputation of the trailing edge on the right lobe; multiple circular scars consistent with ectoparasite attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast mottled 'spray' pattern of black pixels is localized along the boundary of the central black region on the right lobe lobe.
